findingLegend.LD1: A turn delivers no incremental assistant text: answer/thinking deltas are buffered unbounded in the main process and flushed only at attempt boundaries or terminal settlement (G0).
findingLegend.LD2: Reasoning is not a first-class process fact: it is transient renderer-only state, truncated, cleared on attempt reset, never persisted, and read by no component (G0b, G1, G2).
findingLegend.LD3: Tool and approval facts are removed by three independent filters (session read projection, renderer output projection, compact process rows), so the transcript contradicts the live run (G3).
findingLegend.LD4: The disclosure projection engine carries only the answer channel and is not the default renderer path, so process facts never reach the live surface (G4, G5).
findingLegend.LD5: Plan step execution has no process fact, so planning progress is only visible as a status summary (G6).
findingLegend.LD6: There is no streaming visual or assistive state: the is-streaming class has no rules and aria-busy/role=log are absent, while status is partly colour-only (G9, G12).
findingLegend.LD7: Rendering cannot absorb high-frequency deltas: every delta re-allocates all projected messages, defeats memoization, and re-parses growing markdown (G10).
findingLegend.LD8: Governance and continuity guard against this feature: a source-level test forbids tool/reasoning previews in the main interface, and leaving the chat section destroys in-flight state (G13, G11).

workstreams.title: Live delta delivery and render budget
workstreams.architectureDecision: Semantic publication classes replace the unbounded text buffer: text/reasoning runs publish on a bounded time-or-byte window, same-type runs stay joined so redaction state survives a tool or status boundary, and sequence monotonicity, attempt lineage, and idempotency keys are unchanged. No event type, payload field, or persisted schema changes.
workstreams.rollback: Restore all-or-nothing buffering at attempt/terminal boundaries, the per-message projection that re-allocates every message, and the unthrottled scroll effect. No persisted schema or user data is involved.
verification: npm test -- --run src/main/chatService.test.ts src/renderer/chatStreamReducer.test.ts src/renderer/materialDesign.test.ts src/shared/packageScripts.test.ts

workstreams.title: Process fact source: reasoning as a bounded, redacted fact
workstreams.architectureDecision: Reasoning enters the durable fact set as a bounded, redacted block with an explicit provider/persist/deliver/authorize/display gate chain. Raw chain of thought is never persisted or displayed by default; only safe, redacted summaries are eligible for display.
workstreams.rollback: Stop emitting reasoning output parts and drop the reasoning projection; persisted messages keep the bounded redacted blocks as inert data that older renderers ignore.
verification: focused reasoning persistence and redaction tests

workstreams.title: Inline process blocks with attention-driven disclosure
workstreams.architectureDecision: The three process filters become one policy decision driven by the existing disclosure resolver: default collapsed, automatic expansion only for blocking, failed, or waiting states, and user preference may override. The main-conversation guard test is rewritten to assert the new policy instead of the removed implementation.
workstreams.rollback: Re-enable the three filters and restore the previous guard assertion; the projected disclosure mode flag returns to legacy.
verification: focused disclosure policy and renderer tests

workstreams.title: Plan and progress disclosure with intervention points
workstreams.rollback: Remove plan-step facts and intervention affordances; Goal/Plan authority and existing review gates remain unchanged.
verification: focused plan, goal, and approval tests

workstreams.title: Replay, preference, and learning closure
workstreams.rollback: Disable the disclosure preference setting and keep process facts out of trajectory learning candidates; live and persisted views fall back to the LD03 defaults.
verification: focused replay, preference, and episode-export tests
